studies.officialTitle: A Phase 2b Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of PF-06882961 in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Adults With Obesity Without Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
studies.population: Adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus and adults with obesity without type 2 diabetes mellitus.
studies.safetySummary: The peer-reviewed report found no serious treatment-emergent adverse events or deaths. Nausea and vomiting were the most frequent events, increased generally with target dose, and treatment discontinuation was common at higher doses, particularly in the obesity cohort.

studies.officialTitle: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of PF-06882961 in Adults With Obesity
studies.safetySummary: The peer-reviewed report found most treatment-emergent adverse events were mild; serious events occurred in 3.0% overall and no deaths occurred. Nausea and vomiting were the most frequent events, and discontinuation due to adverse events was higher with danuglipron, particularly at higher doses and faster escalation schedules.
